title: Stapel realtime wire envelope v1
description: Every frame on a stapel-realtime socket, in both directions. The envelope is versioned independently of the payload: a module evolves its payload under its own schema, the substrate evolves this wrapper. An L1 library normally publishes no schemas; this one is the deliberate exception (spec 4.1) because the envelope is a contract between a backend consumer and a browser client written by different hands, and it joins the events.json family when that lands.

v.description: Envelope version. A client that does not know this number must fail loudly rather than guess the shape underneath.

type.description: hello/ping/pong are client->server; the rest are server->client (ping/pong travel both ways).

payload.description: Frame body. Its shape belongs to the module, except for the substrate's own frames described below.

seq.description: Monotonic per-stream sequence of a PERSISTED row. Present only on journal frames (replay/live). An ephemeral frame can never carry one: it never touches a persistent model, which is exactly what keeps the two sorts of traffic from mixing.

stream.description: Canonical stream key <mod>:<scope_type>:<scope_id>[:<topic>]. Optional and redundant under the v1 socket-per-stream topology; stamped anyway so a future multiplexed socket can route on it without a breaking envelope change.

hello.description: Client resumes: 'I have everything up to last_seq'. Omitted or 0 means 'I have nothing'.

welcome.description: Subscription accepted. server_seq is the highest sequence the module has persisted for this stream (0 on an ephemeral stream, which has no journal).

replay_done.description: Catch-up finished; everything after this frame is live.

ephemeral.description: One Signal. `signal` is the emitted signal type (e.g. 'recording.status'); the remaining keys are the module's payload. At-most-once by contract — a client that missed it refetches over REST.

error.description: A refusal that does not close the socket. code 'resync' means the resume gap exceeded the replay window and the client must re-hydrate over HTTP pagination.

revoked.description: Rights were withdrawn while the socket was open. Sent immediately before close 4410; reconnecting will not help until access changes.
